prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: If you need believable “creator” testimonials without filming
If your team already designs in templates
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses, **Creatify** is one of the best AI video ad makers because it can turn a product URL, images, or brief into multiple short-form ad variations quickly—especially for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Meta ads.

Best choice depends on the kind of ad you need:

| Need | Best tool | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Fast ecommerce/performance ads | **Creatify** | Generates product ads, hooks, scripts, UGC-style creatives, and variants from a URL |
| AI UGC/avatar ads | **Arcads** or **HeyGen** | Strong AI actors, spokesperson videos, and localization |
| Polished brand/social ads | **Canva** | Easiest all-in-one editor with templates, brand kits, stock assets, and AI tools |
| High-end visual/generative ads | **Runway** | Best for more cinematic AI shots, motion graphics, and creative control |
| Corporate/product explainers | **Synthesia** | Reliable avatars, voiceovers, multilingual presentations |
| Quick repurposing and captions | **CapCut** or **VEED** | Great for editing existing footage into vertical ad formats |

### My practical recommendation
- **If you sell products online:** start with **Creatify**.
- **If you need believable “creator” testimonials without filming:** use **Arcads** or **HeyGen**.
- **If your team already designs in templates:** use **Canva**.
- **If creative quality matters more than speed:** use **Runway**, then edit in CapCut or Premiere.

A strong workflow is: generate 10–20 hooks and versions in Creatify/Arcads, pick the best concepts, then polish captions, pacing, branding, and CTA in CapCut or Canva. The best-performing AI ads usually still need human review for claims, brand voice, and platform compliance.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
